answer: Edge-Density Admission. Agents earn a routing slot only by holding sustained, bidirectional traffic with at least three distinct neighbors over rolling epochs; a new node starts isolated in a sparse meadow of unverified peers. Each identity must maintain a crystal-clear history of forwarded messages whose timing pulse matches neighbor logs. Since fake identities must also relay real traffic and sustain distinct links, each Sybil costs continuous bandwidth and latency budget, scaling linearly with the number of identities.
